vb_textbox.text: So at first I was trying to watch their possitions and their hats colors. green vs pink and brown vs purple, where one gnome would give good advice and the other would give bad advice. It kinda changed throughout the game which color gnome gave good advice, but it was stable for the most part (For example purple colored gnome would give good advice for like 10 round). At the end I started focusing on their beards, too. It could be that the combination of hat color + beard is what gives good advice. So purple hat + pointy bear = good advice, purple hat + round beard = bad advice. The left-right direction maybe has an impact too, but I didn't notice it. I would watch out for hat color and beard form combo the most
